notes.title: New features update!
notes.notes:
Hello folks! 

Loads of new things have been added to Interstellar Invaders!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/de44f7b1222413a1c37d1ff86e9bbdd3828d8613.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30697039/fcce6fe7a626a27888796fff9a8bce30160acdff.png[/img][/url]

'Continues' have been added to the game - as something that can be earned if you get far enough.  This is a big improvement on the balance of the game!

Co-op mode has been greatly refined and dozens of songs have been added to the game, to add divirsity to the soundscape.

On the near horizon: Steam Achievents!
